name: Free Icon Packs | 7750 Icons | Editable Strokes
summary: Figma community icon library of 7,750 free vector icons with fully editable strokes, published by MaxiBlocks.
description: A free Figma community file of 7,750 icons from the MaxiBlocks icon library, grouped into themed packs. Icons keep fully editable strokes and lines — stroke weight, colour, alignment, caps, joins and corner radius — and can be converted to outlines. Only the title and description were readable; Figma renders the rest with JavaScript.
contains: 7,750 icons in one Figma community file
fully editable strokes: weight, colour, alignment, caps, joins, corner radius
